build_block_fusion: build a Block bilinear superdiagonal fusion module with chunked rank-based multimodal feature fusion
build_concat_mlp_fusion: build a ConcatMLP fusion module that concatenates two modalities then passes through an MLP
build_compact_bilinear_pooling: build a CompactBilinearPooling layer that uses FFT-based approximate bilinear pooling for two inputs
build_mfb_fusion: build an MFB multimodal fusion bilinear module with factorized element-wise product fusion
build_mcb_fusion: build an MCB multimodal compact bilinear module using CompactBilinearPooling for feature fusion
